title: Thyroid Test Normal Range — TSH, T3, T4 Report, Deoria
description: TSH, T3 aur T4 ki normal range kya hai, TSH high ya low ka matlab, thyroid test khaali pet ya nahi, aur Deoria me thyroid test ghar par kaise karayein.
takeaways: Thyroid ki report me sabse pehle TSH dekha jaata hai. Vayaskon me ye aam taur par 0.4 se 4.5 mIU/L ke aas-paas hota hai — lekin aakhri range wahi hai jo aapki report par chhapi hai.
TSH ulta chalta hai: TSH zyada matlab thyroid kam kaam kar raha hai (hypothyroid), TSH kam matlab thyroid zyada kaam kar raha hai (hyperthyroid).
Thyroid test ke liye fasting zaroori nahi. Bas thyroid ki goli sample dene ke baad lijiye, aur biotin wali multivitamin 2-3 din pehle rok dijiye.
Dawa ka dose badla hai to TSH 6 se 8 hafte baad dohraiye — usse pehle karaya test sirf uljhan badhata hai.

sections.heading: Thyroid Test Kya Hai — TSH, T3 Aur T4 Teen Alag Number Kyun
sections.lead: Gale ki ek chhoti granthi poore sharir ki raftaar tay karti hai. Test usi raftaar ko naapta hai.
blocks: Thyroid gale ke saamne ek titli jaisi granthi hai jo do hormone banati hai — T4 (thyroxine) aur T3. Ye hormone tay karte hain ki sharir khaana kitni tezi se jalata hai, dil kitna tez chalta hai, garmi-sardi kaisi lagti hai, aur man kaisa rehta hai. In hormone ko kitna banana hai, iska hukm dimaag ki pituitary granthi TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone) bhej kar deti hai.

Isliye thyroid ki jaanch me teen number aate hain. TSH batata hai ki dimaag thyroid se kitna kaam maang raha hai, aur T3-T4 batate hain ki thyroid asal me kitna de raha hai. Deoria me doctor ke parche par ye do tarah se likha milta hai — sirf "TSH", ya "Thyroid Profile" / "T3, T4, TSH". Pehli screening me akela TSH kaafi hota hai; TSH bahar nikle ya doctor poori tasveer dekhna chahe to teeno.

sections.heading: Thyroid Test Normal Range — TSH, T3 Aur T4 Ki Table
sections.lead: Ye aam range hai. Machine aur method ke hisaab se aapki report ki range thodi alag hogi.
blocks: Neeche vayaskon ki woh range hai jo zyadatar labs ki report me isi ke aas-paas milti hai. TSH ki upari seema par sabse zyada farak dikhta hai — kisi lab me 4.2, kisi me 4.5, kisi me 5.0 tak. Isliye apni report par "Biological Reference Interval" wala column hi aakhri maaniye.

sections.heading: TSH High Ya Low Ka Matlab — Report Ke Chaar Aam Pattern
sections.lead: TSH ko hamesha T4 ke saath padhiye. Dono milkar hi kahani poori karte hain.
blocks: TSH ka ek seedha niyam yaad rakhiye: ye thyroid ka ulta chalta hai. Thyroid sust ho to dimaag zyada TSH bhej kar use jagata hai — TSH badh jaata hai. Thyroid zaroorat se zyada chale to dimaag TSH band kar deta hai — TSH gir jaata hai.

blocks: Bharat me sabse aam pattern pehla hai — TSH zyada, yaani hypothyroidism — aur ye mahilaon me purushon se kai guna zyada milta hai. Iski sabse aam wajah autoimmune thyroid (Hashimoto) hai, jismein sharir apni hi thyroid ke khilaaf antibody bana leta hai. Anti-TPO test isi ko pakadta hai.

note.title: Ek report se dawa shuru nahi hoti
note.text: TSH 5-8 ke beech ho aur T4 normal ho, to doctor aksar 6 se 12 hafte baad TSH dohraate hain, kyunki bukhar, beemari ya neend ki kami ke baad TSH kuch waqt ke liye upar aa sakta hai. TSH 10 se upar ho, ya pregnancy plan ho, to faisla jaldi hota hai. Dawa shuru karni hai ya nahi — ye doctor tay karte hain.

sections.heading: Thyroid Test Khaali Pet Hota Hai? Sample Se Pehle Ki Taiyaari
sections.lead: Fasting nahi chahiye — lekin kuch cheezein report badal deti hain.
blocks: Akele thyroid test ke liye khaali pet rehna zaroori nahi hai. Phir bhi subah ka sample lena behtar hai, kyunki TSH raat me thoda badhta hai aur dopahar tak thoda ghatta hai. Har baar lagbhag ek hi samay par sample denge to do report ki tulna seedhi hogi. Aur agar thyroid ke saath sugar ya lipid bhi likha hai, to un par fasting lagegi — tab sabka sample subah ek saath.

sections.heading: Kise Thyroid Test Karana Chahiye — Lakshan Aur Jokhim Ki Soochi
sections.lead: Thyroid ke lakshan dheere aate hain, isliye log unhe umar ya kaam ki thakan samajh lete hain.
blocks: Deoria me thakan, wazan badhna aur baal jhadna itne aam shikayat hain ki log sabse aakhir me thyroid ke baare me sochte hain. Neeche wali kisi bhi baat par ek baar TSH kara lena sasta aur seedha raasta hai.

sections.heading: Thyroid Ki Dawa Chal Rahi Hai — TSH Kab-Kab Dohrayein
sections.lead: Is bimari me asli kaam pehli report nahi, dose ka theek baithna hai.
blocks: Hypothyroidism ki dawa aam taur par lambi chalti hai, aur dose TSH dekh kar hi tay hota hai. TSH dawa badalne ke turant baad nahi badalta — naya santulan banne me kuch hafte lagte hain. Isliye jaldi test karane se dose baar-baar galat disha me badalta hai.

list: Goli subah khaali pet, saade paani se, aur naashte se kareeb aadha-ek ghanta pehle — roz ek hi tarah.
Calcium, iron ki goli aur antacid thyroid ki goli se kuch ghante door rakhiye, warna goli poori nahi lagti.
TSH theek aaya hai to dawa khud band mat kijiye — theek isliye aaya hai kyunki dawa chal rahi hai.
Har report ek hi lab se, aur purani PDF sambhaal kar — doctor do report ka farak dekhte hain.

sections.heading: Gale Me Sujan Ya Gaanth — Blood Test Kya Batata Hai Aur Kya Nahi
sections.lead: Gaanth ka size aur banawat khoon se nahi, jaanch machine se dikhti hai.
blocks: Terai aur uske aas-paas ke ilaakon me pehle ghenga (goitre) kaafi dikhta tha, aur aayodin wale namak ke baad ye kam hua hai. Aaj bhi gale me sujan ya gaanth dikhe to TSH pehla kadam hai — isse pata chalta hai ki thyroid ka kaam badla hai ya nahi.

Lekin gaanth kaisi hai, kitni badi hai, aur usme kuch aur jaanch chahiye ya nahi — ye blood test nahi bata sakta. Iske liye doctor aksar gale ki sonography likhte hain, aur zaroorat par FNAC. Ye dono machine aur doctor par hote hain.

note.title: Sonography hamari service nahi hai
note.text: MedicoBharat Deoria me sirf khoon aur peshab ke sample ghar par leta hai. X-ray, ultrasound/sonography aur ECG hum nahi karte — inke liye aapko imaging centre jaana hi hoga. Sahi kram ye hai: TSH ghar par kara lijiye, aur report le kar sonography ke liye jaaiye, taaki doctor ek hi visit me dono dekh lein.

Isliye Deoria Sadar ke saath Rudrapur, Barhaj, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me bhi sample ghar par liya jaata hai. Deoria me hamara walk-in counter nahi hai — sample ghar se hi liya jaata hai.

faqs.question: TSH ki normal range kya hai?
faqs.answer: Vayaskon me TSH aam taur par 0.4 se 4.5 mIU/L ke aas-paas hota hai. Har lab ki upari seema thodi alag hoti hai — kahin 4.2, kahin 5.0 — isliye apni report par chhapi reference range hi maaniye. Pregnancy, bujurgon aur bachchon me range alag padhi jaati hai.

faqs.question: TSH high hone ka matlab kya hai?
faqs.answer: TSH zyada hone ka aam matlab hai ki thyroid sust hai (hypothyroidism) aur dimaag use zyada hukm bhej raha hai. Agar T4 bhi kam hai to ye poora hypothyroid hai; T4 normal hai to halka ya shuruaati (subclinical). Beemari ke baad TSH thodi der ke liye bhi badh sakta hai, isliye doctor aksar dohraa kar faisla karte hain.

faqs.question: TSH low hone ka matlab kya hai?
faqs.answer: TSH kam hone ka aam matlab hai ki thyroid zaroorat se zyada hormone bana raha hai (hyperthyroidism). Dil tez dhadakna, wazan girna, garmi lagna aur haath kaanpna iske lakshan hain. Thyroid ki dawa ka dose zyada ho to bhi TSH gir jaata hai. T3 aur T4 saath dekh kar doctor tay karte hain.

faqs.question: Thyroid test khaali pet karana zaroori hai?
faqs.answer: Nahi. Akele thyroid test ke liye fasting zaroori nahi hai. Phir bhi subah ka sample behtar hai aur har baar lagbhag ek hi samay par dena chahiye. Thyroid ki goli sample dene ke baad lijiye, aur biotin wali multivitamin 2-3 din pehle band kar dijiye.

faqs.question: Thyroid ki dawa ke baad TSH kab dohrana chahiye?
faqs.answer: Dawa shuru hone ya dose badalne ke 6 se 8 hafte baad. Dose theek baith jaane ke baad aam taur par har 6 se 12 mahine me. Pregnancy ho jaaye to turant doctor ko bataiye, kyunki tab jaanch jaldi-jaldi hoti hai.

faqs.question: TSH aur Thyroid Profile me kya farak hai?
faqs.answer: TSH ek akela test hai jo screening aur dawa ke follow-up me kaafi hota hai. Thyroid Profile me T3, T4 aur TSH teeno aate hain, aur ye tab likha jaata hai jab TSH bahar ho ya doctor poori tasveer dekhna chahein. Kaun sa chahiye, ye parche se tay hota hai.

faqs.question: Deoria me thyroid test ghar par ho sakta hai?
faqs.answer: Haan. Deoria Sadar, Rudrapur, Barhaj, Bhatpar Rani, Gauri Bazar, Baitalpur, Lar aur Bhatni me TSH aur Thyroid Profile ka sample ghar par liya jaata hai. Home collection free hai, slot subah 6 baje se, aur report 24 ghante ke andar WhatsApp tatha email par PDF me aati hai. Daam Deoria ki rate list par dekhiye.
